answer: Proof of Personhood using biometric entropy creates Sybil resistance by anchoring digital IDs to physical uniqueness. Like the pigment of skin or the ferrous trace elements in biological systems, unique human traits prevent mass identity cloning. Agents must traverse the digital knoll of validation through cryptographic signatures of these proofs. The attacker faces an insurmountable cost: they must simulate biological reality, which requires exponentially expensive hardware and physical presence, rendering identity fabrication economically irrational.
